STEP 2: Data Cleaning
```{r}
# ============================================================================
# STEP 2: DATA CLEANING
# ============================================================================

library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

cat(rep("=", 70), "\n")
cat("STEP 2: DATA CLEANING\n")
cat(rep("=", 70), "\n\n")

# ----------------------------------------
# Make a working copy
# ----------------------------------------
data_clean <- data_raw

# ----------------------------------------
# 2.1 Fix repaid (most important)
# ----------------------------------------
cat("Fixing `repaid`...\n")

normalize_repaid <- function(x){
  v <- trimws(tolower(as.character(x)))
  v[v %in% c("0","0.0","false","no","n","not repaid","not_repaid")] <- "0"
  v[v %in% c("1","1.0","true","yes","y","repaid","paid")]         <- "1"
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(v))
}

data_clean$repaid <- normalize_repaid(data_clean$repaid)

if(any(is.na(data_clean$repaid))) stop("ERROR: repaid still contains NA — inspect raw data!")

cat("✓ repaid normalized to numeric (0/1)\n\n")

# ----------------------------------------
# 2.2 size_of_downpayment → numeric decimal
# ----------------------------------------
cat("Fixing size_of_downpayment...\n")

data_clean$size_of_downpayment <- gsub("%","", as.character(data_clean$size_of_downpayment))
data_clean$size_of_downpayment <- trimws(data_clean$size_of_downpayment)
data_clean$size_of_downpayment <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(data_clean$size_of_downpayment)) / 100
data_clean$size_of_downpayment[is.na(data_clean$size_of_downpayment)] <- 0

cat("✓ size_of_downpayment converted to decimal\n\n")

# ----------------------------------------
# 2.3 car_value → numeric
# ----------------------------------------
cat("Fixing car_value...\n")

data_clean$car_value <- gsub("[^0-9\\.-]","", as.character(data_clean$car_value))
data_clean$car_value <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(data_clean$car_value))

if (all(is.na(data_clean$car_value))) stop("ERROR: car_value conversion failed.")

data_clean$car_value[is.na(data_clean$car_value)] <- median(data_clean$car_value, na.rm=TRUE)

cat("✓ car_value cleaned\n\n")

# ----------------------------------------
# 2.4 repaid_loan_on_prev_car → 0/1
# ----------------------------------------
cat("Fixing repaid_loan_on_prev_car...\n")

v <- tolower(trimws(as.character(data_clean$repaid_loan_on_prev_car)))
v[v %in% c("1","true","t","yes","y")] <- 1
v[v %in% c("0","false","f","no","n")] <- 0
data_clean$repaid_loan_on_prev_car <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(v))
data_clean$repaid_loan_on_prev_car[is.na(data_clean$repaid_loan_on_prev_car)] <- 0

cat("✓ repaid_loan_on_prev_car → numeric 0/1\n\n")

# ----------------------------------------
# 2.5 driver_tenure → numeric
# ----------------------------------------
cat("Fixing driver_tenure...\n")

if(!"driver_tenure" %in% names(data_clean)){
  data_clean$driver_tenure <- NA_real_
} else {
  data_clean$driver_tenure <- gsub(",",".", as.character(data_clean$driver_tenure))
  data_clean$driver_tenure <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(data_clean$driver_tenure))
}

cat("✓ driver_tenure cleaned\n\n")

# ----------------------------------------
# 2.6 salary_range prepare cleaned version
# ----------------------------------------
data_clean$salary_range_clean <- tolower(
  gsub("[^0-9k\\+\\-– ]","", as.character(data_clean$salary_range))
)

cat("✓ salary_range cleaned helper column created\n\n")

cat("STEP 2 Completed\n\n")

```



STEP 3: Feature Engineering
```{r}
# ============================================================================
# STEP 3: FEATURE ENGINEERING (FINAL, 8 FEATURES including driver_tenure)
# - Robust cleaning for repaid, salary_range, size_of_downpayment, driver_tenure
# - Creates derived features and selects final 8 features + repaid target
# ============================================================================

# required packages
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
})

cat(rep("=", 70), "\n")
cat("STEP 3: FEATURE ENGINEERING (8 FEATURES)\n")
cat(rep("=", 70), "\n\n")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3.0 Robust cleaning of key columns BEFORE feature engineering
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("=== 3.0 Robust cleaning: repaid, size_of_downpayment, salary_range, driver_tenure, repaid_loan_on_prev_car ===\n\n")

# Ensure data_clean exists
if (!exists("data_clean")) stop("data_clean not found. Run STEP 2 first.")

# 3.0.1 Normalize repaid (accepts "0"/"1", "yes"/"no", logical, etc.)
data_clean <- data_clean %>%
  mutate(
    repaid = as.character(repaid),
    repaid = trimws(tolower(repaid)),
    repaid = case_when(
      repaid %in% c("0", "0.0", "no", "false", "n", "not_repaid", "not repaid", "not-repaid") ~ "0",
      repaid %in% c("1", "1.0", "yes", "true", "y", "repaid", "paid") ~ "1",
      TRUE ~ repaid  # keep whatever else for now (we'll coerce below)
    )
  )

# If repaid is logical (rare), handle it
if (is.logical(data_clean$repaid)) {
  data_clean$repaid <- ifelse(data_clean$repaid, "1", "0")
}

# Try to coerce remaining to numeric (this will convert "0"/"1" -> 0/1)
data_clean$repaid <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(data_clean$repaid)))

# Safety check: if any NA remain in repaid, stop with informative message
if (any(is.na(data_clean$repaid))) {
  na_vals <- unique(data_clean$repaid[is.na(data_clean$repaid)])
  stop("ERROR: repaid contains NA after attempted normalization. Inspect original values. Example NA count: ",
       sum(is.na(data_clean$repaid)))
}

cat("✓ repaid normalized to numeric 0/1 (no NA)\n\n")

# 3.0.2 size_of_downpayment: convert "40%" or "40 % " to decimal 0.4
if ("size_of_downpayment" %in% names(data_clean)) {
  data_clean <- data_clean %>%
    mutate(
      size_of_downpayment = as.character(size_of_downpayment),
      size_of_downpayment = trimws(size_of_downpayment),
      size_of_downpayment = ifelse(size_of_downpayment == "", NA_character_, size_of_downpayment),
      size_of_downpayment = gsub(",", ".", size_of_downpayment),
      size_of_downpayment = gsub("%", "", size_of_downpayment),
      size_of_downpayment = as.numeric(size_of_downpayment) / 100
    )
  # replace any remaining NA with 0 (if you'd rather stop, change this)
  data_clean$size_of_downpayment[is.na(data_clean$size_of_downpayment)] <- 0
  cat("✓ size_of_downpayment cleaned to decimal (example values):\n")
  print(head(data_clean$size_of_downpayment, 5))
  cat("\n")
} else {
  stop("ERROR: size_of_downpayment column not found in data_clean.")
}

# 3.0.3 car_value: remove currency symbols and commas -> numeric
if ("car_value" %in% names(data_clean)) {
  data_clean <- data_clean %>%
    mutate(
      car_value = as.character(car_value),
      car_value = gsub("[^0-9\\.\\-]", "", car_value),
      car_value = trimws(car_value),
      car_value = as.numeric(car_value)
    )
  # if still NA, replace with median as a fallback
  if (all(is.na(data_clean$car_value))) stop("ERROR: car_value conversion produced all NA.")
  data_clean$car_value[is.na(data_clean$car_value)] <- median(data_clean$car_value, na.rm = TRUE)
  cat("✓ car_value cleaned to numeric (example):\n")
  print(head(data_clean$car_value, 5))
  cat("\n")
} else {
  stop("ERROR: car_value column not found in data_clean.")
}

# 3.0.4 repaid_loan_on_prev_car -> numeric 0/1
if ("repaid_loan_on_prev_car" %in% names(data_clean)) {
  data_clean <- data_clean %>%
    mutate(
      repaid_loan_on_prev_car = as.character(repaid_loan_on_prev_car),
      repaid_loan_on_prev_car = trimws(tolower(repaid_loan_on_prev_car)),
      repaid_loan_on_prev_car = case_when(
        repaid_loan_on_prev_car %in% c("1","1.0","true","t","yes","y") ~ 1,
        repaid_loan_on_prev_car %in% c("0","0.0","false","f","no","n") ~ 0,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      )
    )
  # fill NA with 0 (or choose another policy)
  data_clean$repaid_loan_on_prev_car[is.na(data_clean$repaid_loan_on_prev_car)] <- 0
  cat("✓ repaid_loan_on_prev_car normalized to 0/1\n\n")
} else {
  stop("ERROR: repaid_loan_on_prev_car not found.")
}

# 3.0.5 driver_tenure -> numeric (in years). If missing create NA; convert commas->dot
if ("driver_tenure" %in% names(data_clean)) {
  data_clean <- data_clean %>%
    mutate(
      driver_tenure = as.character(driver_tenure),
      driver_tenure = gsub(",", ".", driver_tenure),
      driver_tenure = trimws(driver_tenure),
      driver_tenure = as.numeric(driver_tenure)
    )
  # if some NA, leave as NA - will be handled later
  cat("✓ driver_tenure coerced to numeric (example):\n")
  print(head(data_clean$driver_tenure, 5))
  cat("\n")
} else {
  # create placeholder if absent (will be included but NA)
  data_clean$driver_tenure <- NA_real_
  cat("⚠ driver_tenure not present - created NA column.\n\n")
}

# 3.0.6 salary_range: keep as-is, but prepare a cleaned version for mapping
if ("salary_range" %in% names(data_clean)) {
  data_clean <- data_clean %>%
    mutate(
      salary_range_raw = as.character(salary_range),
      salary_range_clean = tolower(gsub("[^0-9k\\+\\-– ]", "", salary_range_raw)),
      salary_range_clean = trimws(salary_range_clean)
    )
  cat("✓ salary_range cleaned (example):\n")
  print(head(data_clean$salary_range_raw, 6))
  cat("\n")
} else {
  stop("ERROR: salary_range not found.")
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3.1 Create derived features
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("=== 3.1 Creating Derived Features ===\n\n")

data_features <- data_clean %>%
  mutate(
    # Estimated Monthly Income: map either numeric codes or string patterns
    estimated_monthly_income = case_when(
      # numeric codes (if used)
      salary_range %in% c(1, "1") ~ 2500,
      salary_range %in% c(2, "2") ~ 4000,
      salary_range %in% c(3, "3") ~ 6000,
      salary_range %in% c(4, "4") ~ 10000,
      # string patterns (examples: "0 - 20k", "20k - 40k", "40k - 60k", "60k+")
      grepl("0\\s*[-–]\\s*20", salary_range_clean, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ 2000,
      grepl("20\\s*[-–]\\s*40|20k\\s*[-–]\\s*40k", salary_range_clean, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ 4000,
      grepl("40\\s*[-–]\\s*60|40k\\s*[-–]\\s*60k", salary_range_clean, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ 6000,
      grepl("60\\s*\\+|60k", salary_range_clean, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ 10000,
      TRUE ~ 4000
    ),

    # Loan Amount = car_value * (1 - downpayment fraction)
    loan_amount = car_value * (1 - coalesce(size_of_downpayment, 0)),

    # Monthly payment using 8% annual interest, assumed loan_length in months.
    monthly_payment = if_else(
      !is.na(loan_length) & loan_length > 0 & loan_amount > 0,
      (loan_amount * (0.08/12) * (1 + 0.08/12)^loan_length) /
        ((1 + 0.08/12)^loan_length - 1),
      loan_amount / pmax(loan_length, 1)
    ),

    # guard against invalid values
    monthly_payment = if_else(
      is.na(monthly_payment) | is.infinite(monthly_payment) | monthly_payment <= 0,
      loan_amount / pmax(loan_length, 1),
      monthly_payment
    ),

    # payment to income ratio
    payment_to_income = monthly_payment / pmax(estimated_monthly_income, 1),

    # downpayment absolute amount
    downpayment_amount = car_value * coalesce(size_of_downpayment, 0)
  )

cat("✓ Derived features created\n\n")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3.2 Ensure driver_tenure exists (if created earlier as NA it's fine)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (!"driver_tenure" %in% names(data_features)) {
  data_features <- data_features %>% mutate(driver_tenure = NA_real_)
  cat("Note: created driver_tenure as NA.\n\n")
} else {
  cat("driver_tenure present (will be used as-is).\n\n")
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3.3 Select final 8 features and target (strict)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("=== 3.2 Final Feature Selection ===\n\n")

feature_cols <- c(
  "car_value",
  "salary_range",            # keep original column (string or code) if you want; otherwise remove and use salary_range_clean
  "debt_to_income_ratio",
  "loan_length",
  "repaid_loan_on_prev_car",
  "driver_tenure",
  "payment_to_income",
  "downpayment_amount"
)

# Validate presence
missing_feats <- setdiff(feature_cols, names(data_features))
if (length(missing_feats) > 0) stop("Missing feature(s) in data_features: ", paste(missing_feats, collapse = ", "))

data_final <- data_features %>%
  select(all_of(feature_cols), repaid)

# Convert repaid (already numeric 0/1) into factor for modeling
data_final <- data_final %>%
  mutate(
    repaid = factor(repaid, levels = c(0,1), labels = c("Not_Repaid", "Repaid"))
  )

cat("✓ Final dataset created (8 features + repaid)\n\n")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3.4 Feature Summary Statistics & Quick validation
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("=== 3.3 Feature Summary Statistics ===\n\n")

# Numeric features stats
numeric_cols <- data_final %>% select(where(is.numeric))
if (ncol(numeric_cols) > 0) {
  summary_stats_num <- numeric_cols %>%
    summarise(across(everything(), list(
      Mean = ~mean(., na.rm = TRUE),
      SD   = ~sd(., na.rm = TRUE),
      Min  = ~min(., na.rm = TRUE),
      Max  = ~max(., na.rm = TRUE)
    ), .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"))
  summary_long_num <- summary_stats_num %>%
    pivot_longer(everything(),
                 names_to = c("Feature", "Stat"),
                 names_sep = "_",
                 values_to = "Value") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Stat, values_from = Value)
  cat("Numeric features summary:\n")
  print(summary_long_num)
  cat("\n")
} else {
  cat("No numeric features found.\n\n")
}

# Categorical features summary
cat("Categorical features summary:\n")
cat_features <- data_final %>% select(where(is.factor))
if (ncol(cat_features) > 0) {
  for (colname in names(cat_features)) {
    cat(sprintf("\n-- %s --\n", colname))
    freq_tbl <- as.data.frame(table(cat_features[[colname]], useNA = "ifany"))
    names(freq_tbl) <- c("Level", "Count")
    freq_tbl$Pct <- round(100 * freq_tbl$Count / sum(freq_tbl$Count), 2)
    print(freq_tbl)
  }
  cat("\n")
} else {
  cat("No categorical features found.\n\n")
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3.5 Multicollinearity check (numeric only)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("\n=== 3.4 Multicollinearity Check ===\n\n")
numeric_data <- data_final %>% select(where(is.numeric))
if (ncol(numeric_data) > 1) {
  cor_matrix <- cor(numeric_data, use = "complete.obs")
  cat("Correlation matrix (numeric features):\n")
  print(round(cor_matrix, 3))
} else {
  cat("Not enough numeric features for correlation matrix.\n")
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3.6 Final validation checks
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("\n=== 3.5 Validation Checks ===\n\n")
cat(sprintf("Missing values (total): %d\n", sum(is.na(data_final))))
cat(sprintf("Infinite values (predictors): %d\n",
            sum(sapply(data_final %>% select(-repaid), function(x) sum(is.infinite(x))))))

cat("\nTarget distribution:\n")
print(table(data_final$repaid, useNA = "ifany"))

cat("\n✓ STEP 3 COMPLETE\n\n")

```


STEP 4: Train-Test Split
```{r}
# ============================================================================
# STEP 4: TRAIN-TEST SPLIT
# ============================================================================

cat(rep("=", 70), "\n", sep = "")
cat("STEP 4: TRAIN-TEST SPLIT\n")
cat(rep("=", 70), "\n\n", sep = "")

# Set seed for reproducibility
set.seed(42)

# Create stratified split (70% train, 30% test)
train_index <- createDataPartition(
  data_final$repaid,
  p = 0.7,
  list = FALSE,
  times = 1
)

# Split data
train_data <- data_final[train_index, ]
test_data <- data_final[-train_index, ]

# Display split information
cat("Data split summary:\n")
cat(sprintf("  Total observations: %d\n", nrow(data_final)))
cat(sprintf("  Training set: %d (%.1f%%)\n", 
            nrow(train_data), 
            nrow(train_data) / nrow(data_final) * 100))
cat(sprintf("  Test set: %d (%.1f%%)\n\n", 
            nrow(test_data), 
            nrow(test_data) / nrow(data_final) * 100))

# Check class distribution in both sets
cat("Training set distribution:\n")
print(table(train_data$repaid))
cat(sprintf("  Repayment rate: %.2f%%\n\n", 
            mean(train_data$repaid == "Repaid") * 100))

cat("Test set distribution:\n")
print(table(test_data$repaid))
cat(sprintf("  Repayment rate: %.2f%%\n", 
            mean(test_data$repaid == "Repaid") * 100))

cat("\n✓ STEP 4 COMPLETE\n\n")

```
STEP 5: Model 1 - Logistic Regression


```{r}
# ============================================================================
# STEP 5: LOGISTIC REGRESSION (10-fold CV, NA-safe)
# ============================================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(caret)
  library(dplyr)
  library(pROC)
})

cat(rep("=", 70), "\n")
cat("STEP 5: LOGISTIC REGRESSION\n")
cat(rep("=", 70), "\n\n")

train_df <- train_data
test_df  <- test_data

# ----------------------------------------
# Ensure repaid is factor with 2 levels
# ----------------------------------------
if (!is.factor(train_df$repaid)) {
  stop("ERROR: repaid is not factor in train_df — check STEP 2/3")
}

if (length(levels(train_df$repaid)) != 2) {
  stop("ERROR: repaid has less than 2 classes in train_df — cannot train classifier")
}

cat("✓ repaid factor OK\n\n")

# ----------------------------------------
# Fill predictor NA (numeric median / categorical 'Missing')
# ----------------------------------------
num_cols <- names(train_df)[sapply(train_df, is.numeric) & names(train_df)!="repaid"]
cat_cols <- setdiff(names(train_df), c(num_cols,"repaid"))

for(cn in num_cols){
  med <- median(train_df[[cn]], na.rm=TRUE)
  if(is.na(med)) med <- 0
  train_df[[cn]][is.na(train_df[[cn]])] <- med
  test_df [[cn]][is.na(test_df[[cn]])] <- med
}

for(cn in cat_cols){
  # convert to character before factor
  train_df[[cn]] <- as.character(train_df[[cn]])
  test_df [[cn]] <- as.character(test_df [[cn]])
  train_df[[cn]][is.na(train_df[[cn]])] <- "Missing"
  test_df [[cn]][is.na(test_df [[cn]])] <- "Missing"
  lv <- unique(train_df[[cn]])
  train_df[[cn]] <- factor(train_df[[cn]], levels=lv)
  test_df [[cn]] <- factor(test_df [[cn]], levels=lv)
}

cat("✓ NA imputed & factor levels aligned\n\n")

# ----------------------------------------
# caret training control
# ----------------------------------------
train_control <- trainControl(
  method="cv",
  number=10,
  classProbs=TRUE,
  summaryFunction=twoClassSummary,
  savePredictions="final"
)

# ----------------------------------------
# Train GLM Logistic Regression
# ----------------------------------------
cat("Training logistic regression...\n")

predictors <- setdiff(names(train_df), "repaid")

lr_model <- train(
  reformulate(predictors, "repaid"),
  data=train_df,
  method="glm",
  family="binomial",
  trControl=train_control,
  metric="ROC"
)

cat("✓ Model trained\n\n")

# ----------------------------------------
# Coefficients & Odds Ratios
# ----------------------------------------
cat("Coefficients:\n")
print(coef(summary(lr_model$finalModel)))

cat("\nOdds ratios:\n")
odds_ratios <- exp(coef(lr_model$finalModel))
print(odds_ratios)

# ----------------------------------------
# TEST performance
# ----------------------------------------
test_pred_prob <- predict(lr_model, test_df, type="prob")
test_pred <- predict(lr_model, test_df, type="raw")

cm_test <- confusionMatrix(test_pred, test_df$repaid, positive="Repaid")

cat("\nTEST Confusion Matrix:\n")
print(cm_test$table)

cat("\nTEST Metrics:\n")
print(cm_test$overall)
print(cm_test$byClass)

roc_test <- roc(test_df$repaid, test_pred_prob$Repaid, quiet=TRUE)
cat(sprintf("\nTEST ROC-AUC: %.4f\n", auc(roc_test)))

# ----------------------------------------
# TRAIN performance
# ----------------------------------------
train_pred_prob <- predict(lr_model, train_df, type="prob")
train_pred <- predict(lr_model, train_df, type="raw")
cm_train <- confusionMatrix(train_pred, train_df$repaid, positive="Repaid")

cat("\nTRAIN Confusion Matrix:\n")
print(cm_train$table)

cat("\nTRAIN Metrics:\n")
print(cm_train$overall)
print(cm_train$byClass)

roc_train <- roc(train_df$repaid, train_pred_prob$Repaid, quiet=TRUE)
cat(sprintf("\nTRAIN ROC-AUC: %.4f\n", auc(roc_train)))

cat("\n✓ STEP 5 Completed\n\n")


```



STEP 6: Model 2 - Random Forest
```{r}
# ============================================================================
# STEP 6: MODEL 2 - RANDOM FOREST (mtry = 2,3; prints TRAIN & TEST metrics)
# Full, drop-in script — assumes `train_data` and `test_data` already exist.
# ============================================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(caret)
  library(dplyr)
  library(pROC)
  library(randomForest)
})

set.seed(42)

OUT_DIR_RF <- file.path(getwd(), "model_rf_outputs")
dir.create(OUT_DIR_RF, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

cat(rep("=", 70), "\n")
cat("STEP 6: MODEL 2 - RANDOM FOREST (mtry = 2,3)\n")
cat(rep("=", 70), "\n\n")

# ---------------------------
# Pre-checks
# ---------------------------
if (!exists("train_data") || !exists("test_data")) stop("train_data and test_data must exist. Run STEP 4 first.")

cat(sprintf("Train rows: %d, Test rows: %d\n\n", nrow(train_data), nrow(test_data)))

# Ensure target exists & is factor with two levels
if (!"repaid" %in% names(train_data)) stop("train_data must contain 'repaid' column.")
if (!is.factor(train_data$repaid)) {
  train_data$repaid <- factor(train_data$repaid, levels = c(0,1), labels = c("Not_Repaid","Repaid"))
  warning("Converted train_data$repaid to factor (Not_Repaid, Repaid).")
}
if (length(levels(train_data$repaid)) != 2) stop("train_data$repaid must have 2 levels.")

# For test_data: if labeled, coerce similarly (if all NA, keep as-is)
if ("repaid" %in% names(test_data) && !is.factor(test_data$repaid) && any(!is.na(test_data$repaid))) {
  test_data$repaid <- factor(test_data$repaid, levels = c(0,1), labels = c("Not_Repaid","Repaid"))
  warning("Converted test_data$repaid to factor (Not_Repaid, Repaid).")
}

# ---------------------------
# Minimal NA handling for predictors
# ---------------------------
predictor_cols <- setdiff(names(train_data), "repaid")
if (length(predictor_cols) == 0) stop("No predictors found in train_data (only 'repaid').")

num_cols <- predictor_cols[sapply(train_data[predictor_cols], is.numeric)]
cat_cols <- setdiff(predictor_cols, num_cols)

# numeric median impute
for (cn in num_cols) {
  med <- median(train_data[[cn]], na.rm = TRUE)
  if (is.na(med)) med <- 0
  train_data[[cn]][is.na(train_data[[cn]])] <- med
  if (cn %in% names(test_data) && is.numeric(test_data[[cn]])) {
    test_data[[cn]][is.na(test_data[[cn]])] <- med
  }
}

# categorical fill and align levels
for (cn in cat_cols) {
  train_data[[cn]] <- as.character(train_data[[cn]])
  train_data[[cn]][is.na(train_data[[cn]])] <- "Missing"
  train_levels <- unique(train_data[[cn]])
  train_levels <- c(setdiff(train_levels, "Missing"), "Missing")
  train_data[[cn]] <- factor(train_data[[cn]], levels = train_levels)

  if (cn %in% names(test_data)) {
    test_data[[cn]] <- as.character(test_data[[cn]])
    test_data[[cn]][is.na(test_data[[cn]])] <- "Missing"
    # unfamiliar test levels mapped to "Missing"
    test_data[[cn]][!(test_data[[cn]] %in% train_levels)] <- "Missing"
    test_data[[cn]] <- factor(test_data[[cn]], levels = train_levels)
  }
}

cat("NA imputation & factor alignment complete.\n\n")

# ---------------------------
# trainControl (10-fold CV)
# ---------------------------
train_control_rf <- trainControl(
  method = "cv",
  number = 10,
  classProbs = TRUE,
  summaryFunction = twoClassSummary,
  savePredictions = "final",
  verboseIter = TRUE
)

cat("Using 10-fold CV and classProbs = TRUE\n\n")

# ---------------------------
# mtry grid: only 2 and 3
# ---------------------------
tune_grid_rf <- expand.grid(mtry = c(2, 3))
cat("mtry grid:\n"); print(tune_grid_rf); cat("\n")

# ---------------------------
# Train Random Forest
# ---------------------------
cat("Training Random Forest...\n")
start_time <- Sys.time()
set.seed(42)

rf_model <- train(
  form = as.formula(paste("repaid ~", paste(predictor_cols, collapse = " + "))),
  data = train_data,
  method = "rf",
  trControl = train_control_rf,
  tuneGrid = tune_grid_rf,
  metric = "ROC",
  ntree = 400,
  importance = TRUE,
  nodesize = 10,
  maxnodes = 50
)

end_time <- Sys.time()
elapsed <- as.numeric(difftime(end_time, start_time, units = "secs"))
cat(sprintf("\nRF training completed in %.2f seconds\n\n", elapsed))

# ---------------------------
# Model summary & var importance
# ---------------------------
cat("Best tuning parameters:\n"); print(rf_model$bestTune); cat("\n")
cat("Model summary:\n"); print(rf_model); cat("\n")

cat("Variable importance:\n")
rf_imp <- varImp(rf_model, scale = TRUE)
print(rf_imp)
write.csv(as.data.frame(rf_imp$importance), file.path(OUT_DIR_RF, "rf_variable_importance.csv"), row.names = TRUE)
cat("Saved variable importance to:", file.path(OUT_DIR_RF, "rf_variable_importance.csv"), "\n\n")

# ---------------------------
# Predictions & Metrics: TRAIN + TEST (both printed and saved)
# ---------------------------

cat("Evaluating TRAIN set...\n")
train_pred_prob <- predict(rf_model, newdata = train_data, type = "prob")
train_pred_class <- predict(rf_model, newdata = train_data, type = "raw")

if ("repaid" %in% names(train_data) && any(!is.na(train_data$repaid))) {
  cm_train <- confusionMatrix(train_pred_class, train_data$repaid, positive = "Repaid")
  cat("\nTRAIN Confusion Matrix:\n"); print(cm_train$table)
  cat("\nTRAIN Metrics:\n")
  cat(sprintf("  Accuracy:    %.4f\n", as.numeric(cm_train$overall["Accuracy"])))
  cat(sprintf("  Sensitivity: %.4f\n", as.numeric(cm_train$byClass["Sensitivity"])))
  cat(sprintf("  Specificity: %.4f\n", as.numeric(cm_train$byClass["Specificity"])))
  cat(sprintf("  Precision:   %.4f\n", as.numeric(cm_train$byClass["Precision"])))
  cat(sprintf("  F1 Score:    %.4f\n", as.numeric(cm_train$byClass["F1"])))

  # ROC-AUC train
  if (is.data.frame(train_pred_prob) && "Repaid" %in% colnames(train_pred_prob)) {
    roc_train <- tryCatch(roc(response = as.numeric(train_data$repaid == "Repaid"),
                              predictor = as.numeric(train_pred_prob[,"Repaid"]), quiet = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(roc_train)) {
      cat(sprintf("  ROC-AUC:     %.4f\n", as.numeric(auc(roc_train))))
      png(file.path(OUT_DIR_RF, "rf_train_roc.png"), width = 800, height = 600)
      plot(roc_train, main = sprintf("RF Train ROC (AUC=%.4f)", auc(roc_train)))
      dev.off()
      cat("Saved train ROC to:", file.path(OUT_DIR_RF, "rf_train_roc.png"), "\n")
    } else {
      cat("  ROC-AUC:     (could not compute train ROC)\n")
    }
  } else {
    cat("  ROC-AUC:     (train probabilities for 'Repaid' not available)\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("No labeled train rows available; skipping train metrics.\n")
}

cat("\nEvaluating TEST set...\n")
test_pred_prob <- predict(rf_model, newdata = test_data, type = "prob")
test_pred_class <- predict(rf_model, newdata = test_data, type = "raw")

if ("repaid" %in% names(test_data) && any(!is.na(test_data$repaid))) {
  cm_test <- confusionMatrix(test_pred_class, test_data$repaid, positive = "Repaid")
  cat("\nTEST Confusion Matrix:\n"); print(cm_test$table)
  cat("\nTEST Metrics:\n")
  cat(sprintf("  Accuracy:    %.4f\n", as.numeric(cm_test$overall["Accuracy"])))
  cat(sprintf("  Sensitivity: %.4f\n", as.numeric(cm_test$byClass["Sensitivity"])))
  cat(sprintf("  Specificity: %.4f\n", as.numeric(cm_test$byClass["Specificity"])))
  cat(sprintf("  Precision:   %.4f\n", as.numeric(cm_test$byClass["Precision"])))
  cat(sprintf("  F1 Score:    %.4f\n", as.numeric(cm_test$byClass["F1"])))

  # ROC-AUC test
  if (is.data.frame(test_pred_prob) && "Repaid" %in% colnames(test_pred_prob)) {
    roc_test <- tryCatch(roc(response = as.numeric(test_data$repaid == "Repaid"),
                             predictor = as.numeric(test_pred_prob[,"Repaid"]), quiet = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(roc_test)) {
      cat(sprintf("  ROC-AUC:     %.4f\n", as.numeric(auc(roc_test))))
      png(file.path(OUT_DIR_RF, "rf_test_roc.png"), width = 800, height = 600)
      plot(roc_test, main = sprintf("RF Test ROC (AUC=%.4f)", auc(roc_test)))
      dev.off()
      cat("Saved test ROC to:", file.path(OUT_DIR_RF, "rf_test_roc.png"), "\n")
    } else {
      cat("  ROC-AUC:     (could not compute test ROC)\n")
    }
  } else {
    cat("  ROC-AUC:     (test probabilities for 'Repaid' not available)\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("No labeled test rows available; skipping test metrics.\n")
}

# ---------------------------
# Print first 10 rows of train & test (for quick inspection)
# ---------------------------
cat("\n=== TRAIN DATA (first 10 rows) ===\n"); print(head(train_data, 10))
cat("\n=== TEST DATA (first 10 rows) ===\n");  print(head(test_data, 10))

# ---------------------------
# Save predictions & artifacts
# ---------------------------
train_out <- train_data
train_out$pred_class <- as.character(train_pred_class)
train_out$prob_Repaid <- if (is.data.frame(train_pred_prob) && "Repaid" %in% colnames(train_pred_prob)) as.numeric(train_pred_prob[,"Repaid"]) else NA_real_
write.csv(train_out, file.path(OUT_DIR_RF, "train_with_rf_predictions.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

test_out <- test_data
test_out$pred_class <- as.character(test_pred_class)
test_out$prob_Repaid <- if (is.data.frame(test_pred_prob) && "Repaid" %in% colnames(test_pred_prob)) as.numeric(test_pred_prob[,"Repaid"]) else NA_real_
write.csv(test_out, file.path(OUT_DIR_RF, "test_with_rf_predictions.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

saveRDS(rf_model, file.path(OUT_DIR_RF, "rf_model.rds"))
cat("\nSaved train/test predictions and model to:", normalizePath(OUT_DIR_RF), "\n")
cat("\n✓ STEP 6 COMPLETE\n\n")
```

```{r}
# ============================================================================

num_cols <- predictor_cols[sapply(train_data[predictor_cols], is.numeric)]

# Numeric median impute (train -> test)
for (cn in num_cols) {

# Categorical fill + align levels

  if (cn %in% names(test_data)) {

}

cat("NA imputation & categorical level alignment complete.\n\n")

# ---------------------------
```

STEP 8: Model Comparison & Evaluation
```{r}
# ============================================================================
# STEP 8: MODEL COMPARISON AND EVALUATION (Robust)
# - Compares available models on the TEST set
# - Recomputes preds/probs if needed
# ============================================================================
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(caret)
  library(dplyr)
  library(pROC)
})

cat(rep("=", 70), "\n")
cat("STEP 8: MODEL COMPARISON AND EVALUATION (Robust)\n")
cat(rep("=", 70), "\n\n")

# Create summary directory (keep previous variable name compatibility)
SUMMARY_DIR <- file.path(getwd(), "model_comparison_summary")
dir.create(SUMMARY_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ---------------------------
# Basic checks
# ---------------------------
if (!exists("test_data")) stop("Error: test_data not found. Please run STEP 4 and ensure test_data exists.")
if (!"repaid" %in% names(test_data)) stop("Error: test_data must contain 'repaid' column for evaluation.")

# Helper: safe predict class & prob for caret model or existing vars
get_preds_from_model <- function(model_name, model_obj = NULL, test_df) {
  # Returns list(success, pred_class, pred_prob, message)
  res <- list(success = FALSE, pred_class = NULL, pred_prob = NULL, message = NULL)
  tryCatch({
    if (!is.null(model_obj)) {
      # compute class and prob via predict (caret-compatible)
      pred_class <- tryCatch(predict(model_obj, newdata = test_df, type = "raw"), error = function(e) NULL)
      pred_prob  <- tryCatch(predict(model_obj, newdata = test_df, type = "prob"), error = function(e) NULL)
      res$pred_class <- pred_class
      res$pred_prob  <- pred_prob
      res$success <- TRUE
    } else {
      res$message <- "No model object provided"
    }
  }, error = function(e){
    res$success <- FALSE
    res$message <- paste("Predict error:", e$message)
  })
  return(res)
}

# ---------------------------
# Models to check (support alternate naming: lr_model/logit_model, etc.)
# ---------------------------
model_map <- list(
  "Logistic Regression" = if (exists("lr_model")) lr_model else if (exists("logit_model")) logit_model else NULL,
  "Random Forest"       = if (exists("rf_model")) rf_model else NULL,
  "XGBoost"             = if (exists("xgb_model")) xgb_model else NULL
)

# Also accept precomputed preds/probs if available
# support both lr_pred/logit_pred naming
precomp_preds <- list(
  "Logistic Regression" = list(
    class = if (exists("lr_pred")) lr_pred else if (exists("logit_pred")) logit_pred else NULL,
    prob  = if (exists("lr_pred_prob")) lr_pred_prob else if (exists("logit_pred_prob")) logit_pred_prob else NULL
  ),
  "Random Forest" = list(
    class = if (exists("rf_pred")) rf_pred else NULL,
    prob  = if (exists("rf_pred_prob")) rf_pred_prob else NULL
  ),
  "XGBoost" = list(
    class = if (exists("xgb_pred")) xgb_pred else NULL,
    prob  = if (exists("xgb_pred_prob")) xgb_pred_prob else NULL
  )
)

# Determine available models (either model object exists or precomputed preds exist)
available_models <- c()
for (mn in names(model_map)) {
  if (!is.null(model_map[[mn]]) || (!is.null(precomp_preds[[mn]]$class) || !is.null(precomp_preds[[mn]]$prob))) {
    available_models <- c(available_models, mn)
  }
}

if (length(available_models) == 0) stop("No models or precomputed predictions found (lr_model/logit_model, rf_model, xgb_model or lr_pred etc.).")

cat("Models to be compared:\n")
print(available_models)
cat("\n")

# ---------------------------
# Compute metrics per model (on TEST set)
# ---------------------------
results_list <- list()
roc_objects <- list()

for (mn in available_models) {
  cat("Processing model:", mn, "...\n")
  model_obj <- model_map[[mn]]
  # start with precomputed preds if present
  pred_class <- NULL
  pred_prob  <- NULL

  if (!is.null(precomp_preds[[mn]]$class)) {
    pred_class <- precomp_preds[[mn]]$class
  }
  if (!is.null(precomp_preds[[mn]]$prob)) {
    pred_prob <- precomp_preds[[mn]]$prob
  }

  # If missing, try to compute from model object
  if (is.null(pred_class) || is.null(pred_prob)) {
    if (!is.null(model_obj)) {
      pr <- get_preds_from_model(mn, model_obj, test_data)
      if (pr$success) {
        if (is.null(pred_class) && !is.null(pr$pred_class)) pred_class <- pr$pred_class
        if (is.null(pred_prob)  && !is.null(pr$pred_prob))  pred_prob  <- pr$pred_prob
      } else {
        warning(sprintf("Could not generate preds for %s: %s", mn, pr$message))
      }
    } else {
      warning(sprintf("No model object for %s and no precomputed preds found.", mn))
    }
  }

  # Validate presence of predicted class; if still null, skip model
  if (is.null(pred_class)) {
    warning(sprintf("Skipping %s: predicted classes not available.", mn))
    next
  }

  # Ensure pred_class is factor with same levels as test_data$repaid if possible
  if (!is.factor(pred_class)) {
    pred_class <- as.character(pred_class)
    if (all(pred_class %in% c("Repaid","Not_Repaid"))) {
      pred_class <- factor(pred_class, levels = c("Not_Repaid","Repaid"))
    } else if (all(pred_class %in% c("0","1","0.0","1.0"))) {
      pred_class[pred_class %in% c("0","0.0")] <- "Not_Repaid"
      pred_class[pred_class %in% c("1","1.0")] <- "Repaid"
      pred_class <- factor(pred_class, levels = c("Not_Repaid","Repaid"))
    } else {
      # try align to test_data levels
      try({
        pred_class <- factor(as.character(pred_class), levels = levels(test_data$repaid))
      }, silent = TRUE)
    }
  }

  # Compute confusionMatrix only if test labels exist and are not all NA
  metrics <- list()
  if (!all(is.na(test_data$repaid))) {
    # if pred_class length mismatch, warn and continue
    if (length(pred_class) != nrow(test_data)) {
      warning(sprintf("%s: length(pred_class) != nrow(test_data) — skipping metrics for this model.", mn))
      next
    }
    actual <- test_data$repaid
    if (!is.factor(actual)) actual <- factor(actual)
    # align levels if needed
    if (!all(levels(pred_class) %in% levels(actual))) {
      pred_class <- factor(as.character(pred_class), levels = levels(actual))
    }

    cm <- tryCatch(confusionMatrix(pred_class, actual, positive = "Repaid"), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(cm)) {
      warning(sprintf("%s: confusionMatrix failed — skipping.", mn))
      next
    }
    metrics$Accuracy    <- as.numeric(cm$overall["Accuracy"])
    metrics$Sensitivity <- as.numeric(cm$byClass["Sensitivity"])
    metrics$Specificity <- as.numeric(cm$byClass["Specificity"])
    metrics$Precision   <- as.numeric(cm$byClass["Precision"])
    metrics$F1_Score    <- as.numeric(cm$byClass["F1"])
    metrics$Confusion   <- cm$table
  } else {
    warning(sprintf("test_data has no labels (all NA). Skipping confusion/metrics for %s.", mn))
  }

  # ROC-AUC: need numeric probability for positive class "Repaid"
  auc_val <- NA_real_
  roc_obj <- NULL
  if (!is.null(pred_prob) && is.data.frame(pred_prob) && "Repaid" %in% colnames(pred_prob) && !all(is.na(test_data$repaid))) {
    if (nrow(pred_prob) == nrow(test_data)) {
      roc_obj <- tryCatch(roc(response = as.numeric(test_data$repaid == "Repaid"),
                              predictor = as.numeric(pred_prob[,"Repaid"]), quiet = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
      if (!is.null(roc_obj)) {
        auc_val <- as.numeric(auc(roc_obj))
      }
    } else {
      warning(sprintf("%s: predicted-prob length != nrow(test_data), cannot compute ROC.", mn))
    }
  } else {
    if (!is.null(pred_prob) && is.numeric(pred_prob) && length(pred_prob) == nrow(test_data) && !all(is.na(test_data$repaid))) {
      roc_obj <- tryCatch(roc(response = as.numeric(test_data$repaid == "Repaid"),
                              predictor = as.numeric(pred_prob), quiet = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
      if (!is.null(roc_obj)) auc_val <- as.numeric(auc(roc_obj))
    }
  }

  metrics$ROC_AUC <- auc_val

  # store outputs
  results_list[[mn]] <- list(metrics = metrics, pred_class = pred_class, pred_prob = pred_prob)
  roc_objects[[mn]] <- roc_obj

  # print confusion matrix + basic metrics immediately for user
  cat(sprintf("\n--- %s ---\n", mn))
  if (!is.null(metrics$Confusion)) {
    cat("Confusion Matrix (TEST):\n"); print(metrics$Confusion)
    cat(sprintf("Accuracy: %.4f | Sensitivity: %.4f | Specificity: %.4f | Precision: %.4f | F1: %.4f | ROC-AUC: %s\n\n",
                metrics$Accuracy, metrics$Sensitivity, metrics$Specificity, metrics$Precision, metrics$F1_Score,
                ifelse(is.na(metrics$ROC_AUC), "NA", sprintf("%.4f", metrics$ROC_AUC))))
  } else {
    cat("No confusion/metrics (test labels missing)\n\n")
  }
}

# ---------------------------
# Build comparison table (only metrics present)
# ---------------------------
if (length(results_list) == 0) stop("No model produced metrics; cannot compare.")

metric_names <- c("Accuracy","Sensitivity","Specificity","Precision","F1_Score","ROC_AUC")
comp_df <- data.frame(Model = character(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

for (mn in names(results_list)) {
  m <- results_list[[mn]]$metrics
  row <- sapply(metric_names, function(k) if (!is.null(m[[k]])) as.numeric(m[[k]]) else NA_real_)
  comp_df <- rbind(comp_df, data.frame(Model = mn, t(row), stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
}
rownames(comp_df) <- NULL
colnames(comp_df) <- c("Model", metric_names)

# round for nicer display
comp_df[metric_names] <- lapply(comp_df[metric_names], function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), NA, round(x, 6)))

cat("\n=== Performance Comparison Table (TEST) ===\n")
print(comp_df)
cat("\n")

# Save comparison table to CSV
comp_csv_path <- file.path(SUMMARY_DIR, "model_comparison_test_metrics.csv")
write.csv(comp_df, comp_csv_path, row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved comparison CSV to:", comp_csv_path, "\n\n")

# ---------------------------
# Best model per metric
# ---------------------------
cat("=== Best Model per Metric ===\n\n")
for (mn in metric_names) {
  vals <- comp_df[[mn]]
  if (all(is.na(vals))) {
    cat(sprintf("- %s: no values\n", mn)); next
  }
  best_idx <- which.max(vals)
  cat(sprintf("- %s: %s (%.6f)\n", mn, comp_df$Model[best_idx], vals[best_idx]))
}
cat("\n")

# ---------------------------
# Overall ranking by average rank across metrics (lower avg rank = better)
# ---------------------------
# rank each metric descending (best gets rank 1)
rank_matrix <- sapply(metric_names, function(k) {
  v <- comp_df[[k]]
  if (all(is.na(v))) return(rep(NA_real_, length(v)))
  rank(-v, ties.method = "average", na.last = "keep")
})
avg_rank <- rowMeans(rank_matrix, na.rm = TRUE)
comp_df$Avg_Rank <- round(avg_rank, 4)

order_idx <- order(comp_df$Avg_Rank, na.last = TRUE)
cat("=== Overall Ranking (by average rank across metrics) ===\n\n")
print(comp_df[order_idx, ])
cat("\nOverall best model (lowest Avg_Rank): ", comp_df$Model[order_idx[1]], "\n\n")

# Save ranked comparison
ranked_csv_path <- file.path(SUMMARY_DIR, "model_comparison_ranked.csv")
write.csv(comp_df[order_idx, ], ranked_csv_path, row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved ranked comparison CSV to:", ranked_csv_path, "\n\n")

# ---------------------------
# Save best model summary (based on Avg_Rank first, fallback to ROC_AUC)
# ---------------------------
best_overall <- comp_df$Model[order_idx[1]]
best_row <- comp_df[order_idx[1], ]

# fallback: if Avg_Rank NA, choose max ROC_AUC
if (is.na(best_row$Avg_Rank)) {
  if (!all(is.na(comp_df$ROC_AUC))) {
    best_overall <- comp_df$Model[which.max(comp_df$ROC_AUC)]
    best_row <- comp_df[comp_df$Model == best_overall, ]
  }
}

best_summary_path <- file.path(SUMMARY_DIR, "best_model_summary.txt")
writeLines(
  c(
    paste("Best Model (by Avg_Rank or ROC_AUC):", best_overall),
    paste("Avg_Rank:", ifelse(is.na(best_row$Avg_Rank), "NA", best_row$Avg_Rank)),
    paste("ROC_AUC:", ifelse(is.na(best_row$ROC_AUC), "NA", best_row$ROC_AUC)),
    paste("Accuracy:", ifelse(is.na(best_row$Accuracy), "NA", best_row$Accuracy)),
    paste("Precision:", ifelse(is.na(best_row$Precision), "NA", best_row$Precision)),
    paste("Sensitivity (Recall):", ifelse(is.na(best_row$Sensitivity), "NA", best_row$Sensitivity)),
    paste("F1_Score:", ifelse(is.na(best_row$F1_Score), "NA", best_row$F1_Score))
  ),
  best_summary_path
)
cat("Saved best model summary to:", best_summary_path, "\n\n")

# ---------------------------
# ROC curve comparison plot (if any ROC objects exist)
# ---------------------------
cat("=== ROC Curve Comparison ===\n")
roc_plot_models <- names(roc_objects)[sapply(roc_objects, function(x) !is.null(x))]
if (length(roc_plot_models) == 0) {
  cat("No ROC objects available to plot (missing probabilities or labels).\n")
} else {
  # choose colors (limited palette)
  cols <- c("blue","red","green","purple","orange","brown","cyan")
  png_fname <- file.path(SUMMARY_DIR, "model_comparison_roc.png")
  png(png_fname, width = 900, height = 700)
  first <- TRUE
  i <- 1
  legend_labels <- c()
  legend_cols <- c()
  for (mn in roc_plot_models) {
    roc_obj <- roc_objects[[mn]]
    if (is.null(roc_obj)) next
    if (first) {
      plot(roc_obj, col = cols[i], lwd = 2, main = "ROC Curve Comparison")
      first <- FALSE
    } else {
      lines(roc_obj, col = cols[i], lwd = 2)
    }
    legend_labels <- c(legend_labels, sprintf("%s (AUC=%.4f)", mn, as.numeric(auc(roc_obj))))
    legend_cols <- c(legend_cols, cols[i])
    i <- i + 1
    if (i > length(cols)) i <- 1
  }
  legend("bottomright", legend = legend_labels, col = legend_cols, lwd = 2)
  dev.off()
  cat("Saved ROC comparison to:", png_fname, "\n")
}

cat("\n=== STEP 8 COMPLETE ===\n")
cat(rep("=", 70), "\n\n")
```
